# bits/bxor_assign

> Bitwise-xor assignment: x ^= y, short for x = x ^ y.

truck [bits](../bits.md) · [source](../../../registry/bits/bxor_assign.pkg)

```
let n = 12
n ^= 10
print n           // 6
```

The left side can be any place of type `int`: a variable, a field, a
slice element or `*p`, evaluated once.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
{x: place int} ^= {y: expr int}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` |  | — |
| `y` | expression | `int` |

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following

*{$p} = *{$p} ^ {y}
